details.q: 一共有多少条岗位数据？

details.q: 通过筛选的岗位有多少条？

details.q: AI 应用方向的岗位，月薪上限最高是多少 K？
details.sql: SELECT MAX(salary_max_k) AS max_salary_k FROM jobs WHERE keyword = 'AI应用' AND salary_kind = 'monthly' LIMIT 200
details.gold: SELECT MAX(salary_max_k) AS max_k FROM jobs WHERE keyword = 'AI应用'
details.answer: AI 应用方向的岗位月薪上限最高是 200K。这表明在 AI 应用领域存在薪资水平相当高的高端职位。

details.q: 全部岗位按 keyword 分组，每个方向各有多少条？
details.sql: SELECT keyword AS direction, COUNT(*) AS count FROM jobs GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY keyword LIMIT 200
details.gold: SELECT keyword, COUNT(*) AS n FROM jobs GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY n DESC
details.answer: AI应用方向有15条岗位，Java开发方向有15条岗位，Python方向有16条岗位，后端开发方向有14条岗位，大模型方向有14条岗位，数据分析方向有15条岗位，测试开发方向有15条岗位，算法工程师方向有15条岗位。Python方向的岗位数量最多，而后端开发和大模型方向的岗位数量相对较少。

details.q: 哪个区的岗位数量最多（不算没写区的）？
details.sql: SELECT district, COUNT(job_id) AS count FROM jobs WHERE district != '' GROUP BY district ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 1
details.gold: SELECT district, COUNT(*) AS n FROM jobs WHERE district <> '' GROUP BY district ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1
details.answer: 南山区有 36 个岗位，是岗位数量最多的区域。其他区域没有符合条件的岗位。

details.q: 南山区和福田区各有多少个岗位？
details.sql: SELECT district, COUNT(job_id) AS job_count FROM jobs WHERE district IN ('南山区', '福田区') GROUP BY district LIMIT 200
details.gold: SELECT district, COUNT(*) AS n FROM jobs WHERE district IN ('南山区','福田区') GROUP BY district ORDER BY district
details.answer: 南山区有36个岗位，福田区有11个岗位。南山区的岗位数量明显多于福田区。
